notesStmt.note: Rāma Beside Himself (Unmattarāghava) is a one-act Sanskrit drama by the 15th-century Sangama king Virūpāḳsadeva that reimagines the famous golden deer episode of Vālmīki’s Rāmāyaṇa as an intensely lyrical study of madness (unmāda) occasioned by love in separation. In the traditional narrative, the demon Mārīca disguises himself as a golden deer in order to draw Rāma away and enable Rāvaṇa to abduct Sītā; Virūpāḳsadeva’s play...

editorialDecl.p: I (T. Neill) produced this HANSEL edition. I first manually extracted T. Richard's submitted Word document to plain-text, then added basic structural markup (page breaks, tabbed verses, marking of stage directions and Prakrit). Next, I re-OCRed the PDF (Cloud Vision and Sarvam Vision auto-harmonized with Gemini 2.5 Flash) to recover line-break information, then merged this information into the structured transcript. Finally, I interviewed T. Richard for much of the metadata (the Work Description is entirely his) and ingested the data into HANSEL. T. Richard and I then proofread and reviewed presentation features together (shoutout to Filter Kaapi in Brooklyn!)

The source edition is printed in Devanāgarī; the electronic text uses lossless IAST transliteration. IAST differs slightly from ISO 15919; conversion can be achieved via:
ṛ → r̥
ḷ → l̥
ḻ → ḷ
ṃ → ṁ
e → ē
o → ō

lg.l: herambāya namastasmai yadgaṇḍagṛhamedhinām |
madhuvratānāṃ saṃgītavaikharī bhavati trayī || 1 ||

ambhojasaṃbhavamukhāmbujarājahaṃsī
vālmīkikokilavilāsavasantalakṣmīḥ |

dvaipāyanāmbudhivijṛmbhaṇacandrarekhā
vāgdevatā vijayatāṃ kavikāmadhenuḥ || 2 ||

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p:
nepathyaṃ prati ārye, vijñāpito'hamaruṇācalanāthasya rathotsava
sabhāstāraiḥ |

p.seg: ayya, kīriso ṇideso ayyamissāṇaṃ?ārya, kīdṛśo nideśa āryamiśrāṇām?

lg.l: pautro bukkanarendrasya dauhitro rāmabhūpateḥ |
vidyate hi virūpākṣo rājā hariharātmajaḥ || 3 ||

p.seg:
ṇaṃ so saaḻakaḻāviakkhaṇo tuṇḍīramaṇḍaḻamaṇḍaṇaṃ maragaau
aḻaṃkarei |nanveṣa sakalakalāvicakṣaṇastuṇḍīramaṇḍalamaṇḍanaṃ marakatapuramalaṃkaroti |

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p:
tasya rājñaḥ karṇāṭatuṇḍīracolapāṇḍyamaṇḍalādhipateḥ siṃhaladvīpa
vinyastavijayastambhasya ṣoḍaśamahādānadīkṣitasya sakalakalāvilā
sinīsvayaṃvarapateḥ kṛtimunmattarāghavaṃ nāma prekṣaṇakaṃ prayogato darśayeti |

lg.l:
ṇūṇaṃ imassa mahurāi suhāsiāi
āṇaṃdabaṃdhacariaṃ pahuṇo rahūṇaṃ |

ahmo paoaṇiuṇā guṇamettaḻaggā
sāmāiā iha ṇa kiṃ ṇu siḻāhaṇijjaṃ || 4 ||
nūnamasya madhurāṇi subhāṣitānyānandabandhacaritaṃ prabho raghūṇām |
vayaṃ prayoganipuṇā guṇamātralagnāḥ sāmājikā iha na kiṃ nu ślāghanīyam ||

śrayata katicidbhaktyā saṃgītamaṅgaladevatāṃ
kuruta murajadhvānaiḥ kecitkalairmukharā diśaḥ |

sarasamucitairanye rāgairniṣiñcata vāṅmayaṃ
bibhṛta ca pare tūrṇaṃ nānāvidhāmiha varṇikām || 5 ||

p.seg: ayya, maha vi āṇavehi karaṇijjaṃ |ārya, mamāpyājñāpaya karaṇīyam |

sp.speaker: sūtradhāraḥ
sp.p: ārye, tvayāpi samayocitaṃ gīyatām | saṃprati hi —

lg.l: vanatarusubhagaṃkaraṇī mṛdupavanā mukharakokilabhramarā |
lalitā vasantavelā sukhino'pi karoti sotkaṇṭhān || 6 ||
osāasaṃṇiruddhaṃ puṇo vi āsāsiaṃ vasaṃteṇa |
āṇaṃdei padumiaṇīṃ aṇurāamahappiaṃ sūro || 7 ||
avaśyāyasaṃniruddhāṃ punarapyāśvāsitāṃ vasantena |
ānandayati padminīmanurāgamahāpriyāṃ sūryaḥ ||

p.seg: kahaṃ kaā evva raṃgājīvehiṃ bhūmiā?kathaṃ kṛtā eva raṅgājīvairbhūmikāḥ?

lg.l:
kaikeyyāḥ priyakāraṇāddaśarathasyājñāṃ vahanmaulinā
sītālakṣmaṇasevito raghupatiḥ prāpto vanaṃ daṇḍakām |

hantā śūrpaṇakhābhiṣaṅgamilitānekaḥ kharādīnasau
mārīcena daśānanārthamadhunā māyāvinā vañcyate || 8 ||

p.seg: tā amho vi sajjīhavāmo aṇaṃtarakaraṇijjassa |tasmādvayamapi sajjībhavāmo'nantarakaraṇīyasya |

lg.l: śṛṅgeṇa māṇikyamayena dantairmuktāmayairvajramayaiḥ khurairnaḥ |
vālena nīlāśmamayena cāsau kautūhalaṃ hemamṛgaḥ karoti || 9 ||
gairahasagumbhiehiṃ raaṇamaāṇaṃ ruihi aṅgāṇaṃ |
saamahasarāsaṇāiṃ viraaīva mahīaḻe hariṇo || 10 ||
gatirabhasagumbhitai ratnamayānāṃ rucibhiraṅgānām |
śatamakhaśarāsanāni viracayatīva mahītale hariṇaḥ ||

marakatarucā jaṅghākāṇḍena śādvalayanmahīṃ
kuvalayamayīrāśāḥ kurvannapāṅgavivartanaiḥ |

gaganamakhilaṃ gātroddyotaiḥ savidyudivāvahan
kanakahariṇaḥ ko'yaṃ meroḥ kiśora ivāgataḥ || 11 ||

p.seg:
ayyautta, gahijjadu jīvaggāhaṃ eso | ṇaṃ uṇa dabbhaṃkurehiṃ
vaddhia aoddhaṃ ṇaissāmi |āryaputra, gṛhyatāṃ jīvagrāhameṣaḥ | enaṃ punardarbhāṅkurairvardhayitvā ayodhyāṃ neṣyāmi |

lg.l:
vayamapakṛtavanto yajjanasthānabhājā
matikuṭilamatīnāṃ bhayasāṃ rākṣasānām |

niyatamidamapi syādvañcanaṃ gūḍhaveṣo
racayitumupayātaḥ ko'pi naktaṃcaro naḥ || 12 ||

p.seg:
vacca ḻakkhaṇa, ṇihaesu kharadūsaṇatisirappamuhesu rakkhasesu ṇāruhasi
avae uppekkhiduṃ paccūhaṃ kouhaḻassa |vatsa lakṣmaṇa, nihateṣu kharadūṣaṇatriśiraḥpramukheṣu rākṣaseṣu nārhasyapade utprekṣituṃ pratyūhaṃ kautūhalasya |

lg.l:
sāraṅgo yadi kāryameva hi tathā sītā yathāśaṃsate
rakṣaścedabhayapradasya yamināṃ mṛgyaṃ kirīṭaṃ mama |

gatvāhaṃ vinivṛtta eṣa sahasā jāgartu tāvadbhavā
netasyāḥ parirakṣaṇāya bharataḥ sāketalakṣmyā iva || 13 ||
āryo'nveti mṛgaṃ haimaṃ dhanvī kautūhalānvitaḥ |
airaṃmadamiva jyotiḥ pavanaprerito ghanaḥ || 14 ||
pāḻei ayyautto jaha jaha purado maṇippahāevva |
taha taha majjai maṃdaṃ mama hiaaṃ aṃdhaārammi || 15 ||
palāyatyāryaputro yathā yathā purato maṇiprabheva |
tathā tathā majjati mama hṛdayamandhakāre ||

purastādādhāvatyatijavamudastāgracaraṇo
vivṛttagrīvaḥ sannasakṛdayamālokayati mām |

kṣaṇād dṛśyaḥ pārśve nivasati karagrāhya iva me
kṣaṇaṃ bhūyo dṛṣṭerapi na viṣayaṃ yāti hariṇaḥ || 16 ||
agre paścātpārśvayorūrdhvamarvāgālakṣyo'sāvutpatan yaugapadyāt |
dṛṣṭiṃ dhatte mayyapi krūratāraṃ naitadvanyeṣvanyasattveṣu manye || 17 ||
ayamantarito vanāntavṛkṣairnibiḍairindurivāmbudairmamādya |
adhunāpyanivṛtta eva kasmānnanu māyāhariṇena vañcitaḥ syāt || 18 ||

p.seg: kahaṃ dāṇiṃ ayyauttovi ciraai | phurai me dakkhiṇaṃ ṇaaṇaṃ |kathamidānīmāryaputro'pi cirayati | sphurati me dakṣiṇaṃ nayanam |
vacca lakkhaṇa, tuvara tuvara ayyauttaṃ parittāduṃ |vatsa lakṣmaṇa, tvarasva tvarasvāryaputraṃ paritrātum |

sp.speaker: lakṣmaṇaḥ
sp.p:
karṇau pidhāya śāntaṃ pāpaṃ śāntaṃ pāpam | ārye, kimaviditārya
śauryeva bhāṣase |

lg.l: anabhijñā pralāpānāmīdṛśāṃ mama vaṃśajāḥ |
idamākranditaṃ prāyo māyā tasyaiva rakṣasaḥ || 19 ||

p.seg: ṇa juttaṃ saṃsae uvekkhiduṃ |na yuktaṃ saṃśaye upekṣitum |

lg.l:
vidalitavato bāṇenaikena saṃyati tāṭakā
mapi jitavato viśvāmitrasya satravirodhinaḥ |

saha bhṛgubhuvo garveṇaiśaṃ ca bhagnavato dhanuḥ
kharavijayinastasyāpyāryasya hanta vipatkutaḥ || 20 ||
āryāmekākinīṃ tyaktvā kāntāre gamyatāṃ katham |
kathaṃ vā girametasya śrutvāpi sthīyatāṃ mayā || 21 ||

p.seg: kumāra, tuvara tuvara dāva bhādaraṃ parittāduṃ |kumāra, tvarasva tvarasva tāvat bhrātaraṃ paritrātum |

lg.l:
iyamiha vanasīmni niḥsahāyā
chalabahulāśca niśācarāścaranti |

ayamahamapi yāta eva paścāt
kimiha bhaviṣyati hā vidhe vidheyam || 22 ||

p.seg: ṇa juttaṃ ettha ekāe maha avaṭṭhāṇaṃ | jāva uḍaabbhantaraṃ gacchemi |na yuktamatra ekāyā mamāvasthānam | yāvaduṭajābhyantaraṃ gacchāmi |

lg.l: avyākulagatirāryo diṣṭyāyamitaḥ parāpatati |
kuhanāmṛgaṃ nimeṣānniyatamiṣorāmiṣaṃ kṛtvā || 23 ||

bhavatu hariṇaḥ so'yaṃ māyāparaḥ kṣaṇadācaro
mama kimiyatā hīnaṃ labdhaṃ hi patribhirāmiṣam |

tadapi kṛtakaṃ tasyākrandaṃ niśamya sasādhvasā
bhavati sutarāṃ sītā jānātīdaṃ tu sa lakṣmaṇaḥ || 24 ||

tvaduktaṃ saumitre pariṇatamitaḥ kūṭahariṇo
nayanmāṃ mārīcaḥ samajani śarasyāpi viṣayaḥ |

tvamevaṃ tattvajñaḥ kathamiha videhādhipasutā
maraṇye hitvaikāmanupatasi sāśaṅka iva mām || 25 ||

sp.speaker: lakṣmaṇaḥ
sp.p:
ārya, durātmanastasya tādṛśamākranditaṃ śrutvā sodvegayāryayā
bahuśa āśvāsyamānayāpi balāt tvatsaṃnidhimahaṃ preṣitaḥ |

sp.speaker: rāmaḥ
sp.p:
manye durātmanastasya rākṣasahatakasyākranditaṃ śrutvā mama kimapya
tyāhitamāśaṅkamānā bhītabhītā jānakīti |

sp.speaker: lakṣmaṇaḥ

lg.l:
aviralagaladbāṣpā dṛṣṭirgataṃ skhalitottaraṃ
karuṇakaruṇā vāco mātrātigaḥ śvasitānilaḥ |

vadanamadhikamlānaṃ kārśyaṃ yayau ca vapuḥ kṣaṇā
dayamupagataḥ prāyeṇāsyāpi cetasi vibhramaḥ || 26 ||

sp.p:
tanna yuktaṃ mama sāṃpratamanyato gamanam | tathāpyāryāyāḥ pratyānayanaṃ
vinā nānyadasya śokopaśamanahetuḥ |

sp.speaker: rāmaḥ
sp.p:
āhvayāmi tāvadimāṃ kiṃciduccaiḥ | jānaki jānaki, maithili
maithili, vaidehi vaidehi, dharaṇisute dharaṇisute, sīte sīte, kva
yātāsi?

lg.l: adhunaiṣa vilaṅghya vā payodhīnapi kṛtvā samaraṃ niśācarairvā |
raghuvīrapadāmbujaprabhāvāt punarāhartumalaṃ bhaveyamāryām || 27 ||

rāmasya pañcavaṭi jāgṛhi rakṣaṇāya
sītāviyogavidhurasya vinodanaistvam |

godāvari tvamapi devi taraṅgavātai
rāśvāsayainamaravindavimardaśītaiḥ || 28 ||

sp.speaker: rāmaḥ
sp.p:
karṇaṃ datvā kathamuṭajāṅgaṇacūtavāṭikāyāmuttaramiva śrūyate mañju
bhāṣiṇyāḥ | parikrāman vibhāvya dhik, priyatamālāpasaṃvādinā
parabhṛtarutena pratārito'smi | pṛcchāmi tāvadimameva |

lg.l: pañcamo'pi tava kokila svaraḥ ṣaṣṭha eṣa madanasya sāyakaḥ |
ślāghyatāmitaradurlabhāmimāṃ dhārayāśu mama darśaya priyām || 29 ||

malayamarutaṃ śvāsenāṅgena campakasaṃpadaṃ
karatalarucā raktāśokaṃ mukhena saroruham |

adhararucakenātanvānā navāmradalaśriyaṃ
tava suvadanā kuryānnityaṃ vasantamahotsavam || 30 ||

sp.p:
vibhāvya kathamayamasaṃbhāvitāsmadābhāṣaṇaścūtāṅkurānāsvādayitu
mārabhate | kimamunā svakāryaikaprasaktena? yāvadasyāpyupajīvyaṃ sahakāramevā
bhyarthaye |

lg.l:
saṃgītagehamasi bhṛṅgavilāsinīnāṃ
tvatsaṃgamena surabhirmalayānilo'pi |

śākhāstavaiva khalu puṣpaśarāstraśālā
statkiṃ na yena jagati prathito rasāla || 31 ||
ehi sahakāra dehi prativacanaṃ darśayāśu vaidehīm |
athavā kathaṃ nu ghaṭatāmartho'yaṃ sthāvarādbhavataḥ || 32 ||
ihaiva yadi me subhrūrāyāsyati tadā bhavān |
rāmasya vyasanaṃ tasyai nivedayitumarhati || 33 ||

raktāśokataruḥ sa eṣa sadayaṃ godāvarīvāribhi
ryaṃ putrīkṛtamatra vardhitavatī sītā svahastāhṛtaiḥ |

saṃpratyeva hi vīkṣituṃ mṛgadṛśo vaktraśriyaṃ vāñchatā
yasyādāya mayā navaṃ kisalayaṃ karṇāvataṃsīkṛtam || 34 ||

kva nu gatavatī bālāśoka priyā mama kathyatāṃ
na khalu bhavato vātsalyena vrajatyanivedya sā |

kṣaṇamapi tayā rāmaḥ sāraṅgalocanayā vinā
na hi nivasatyetanmanye tavāpi parisphuṭam || 35 ||

ayi śaṃsa śikhāvala tvameva
sthitavānaṅgaṇabālanīpamūrdhni |

uṭajāntaravāsinī kva yātā
vipine sādhvasinī vilāsinī me || 36 ||

sp.p:
vibhāvya kimayaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ diśamuddiśannuḍḍīnaḥ | nūnaṃ madarthaṃ sītā
nveṣaṇaparaḥ syāt |

lg.l: tiryañcamapi jātyainaṃ bahumanyetarāmaham |
yaḥ sītānveṣaṇe saktaḥ sa hi rāmasya bāndhavaḥ || 37 ||

tvamapi gamito daivenādyāsi barhiṇa śocyatāṃ
kathaya purataḥ kā vā valgatpayodharamaṇḍalam |

taralanayanā tālaiḥ śiñjānakāñcanakaṅkaṇai
stava sulalitaṃ tanvī tanvīta tāṇḍavaśikṣaṇam || 38 ||

iyaṃ hi navamālikā tarurayaṃ navaścampako
yathocitamimāvubhau dayitayā kṛtau dampatī |

mithaḥ sati samāgame madhumiṣādvadhūḥ svedinī
patiḥ pulakajālakaṃ vahati korakavyājataḥ || 39 ||
vada campaka vāmalocanā na hi te locanagocaraṃ prayātā |
kuṭilālakasaṃstavena yasyāḥ sulabho bhṛṅgasamāgamastavāpi || 40 ||
ya eṣa sītāvirahāturaṃ māṃ dagdhuṃ pravṛttasya manobhavasya |
āgneyamastraṃ kusumāpadeśāddhatte sa kiṃ darśayati priyāṃ me || 41 ||
eṣa hi kesarataruḥ kusumairyasya srajaṃ mayā grathitām |
parirambhaṇotsaveṣvapi kāntā kaṇṭhāvalambinīṃ sahate || 42 ||

ācakṣva me bakula kiṃ mahilātra dṛṣṭā
tūṣṇīṃ sthito'si nanu te'sti ruṣo'vakāśaḥ |

sā vismitena bhavato mukulāni tanvī
tvatsaurabhaṃ jayati niśvasitaṃ ca tasyāḥ || 43 ||
bālo'yaṃ purataḥ priyālakatarurnātra priyālāpinī
namraḥ puṣpabharairayaṃ kurabako nāstyatra tuṅgastanī |
ālīnabhramarālireṣa tilako naivātra lolekṣaṇā
puṃnāgo'yamudīrṇakesarabharo nātrāpi me susmitā || 44 ||

sp.p:
tatkathaṃ punaradhigantavyaḥ priyodantaḥ? nanvayaṃ mandānilo'nu
yoktavyaḥ | upasṛtya

lg.l:
gotre candanaśītale tvamudabhūḥ sevyaḥ sadā bhoginā
mullāsāya bhavasyalaṃ sumanasāmāmodavān vījasi |

mantritvaṃ bhajase ca manmathamahārājasya dākṣiṇyavā
nevaṃ tvaṃ guṇināṃ varaḥ praṇayinīmehyehi me darśaya || 45 ||

kvacit kisalayāśrayaṃ kvacana rājarambhānvayaṃ
kvacidgaganavibhramaṃ kvacana mallikāmelanam |

kvacit kamalasaṃstavaṃ kvacana cakrikāśleṣaṇaṃ
kvacit kuvalayākaravyatikaraṃ ca yāto bhavān || 46 ||

sp.p:
vibhāvya aye, kisalayacalanānugatirayamapakrāntavāneva mama priyā
manveṣayitum | santi khalu paropakāravyasaninaḥ santaḥ | bhavatu | vicitāḥ
khalvimāḥ parṇaśālābhyarṇabhūmayaḥ | nirgatya kva vā mayā priyāpravṛttiradhi
gantavyā? hanta hanta,

lg.l: durlabhadayitānveṣaṇadurvāramanorathasya me bhramataḥ |
tatpūrvapade deśe sthātumapi dadāti no daivam || 47 ||
pravālapāṭalābhena śukaścañcūpuṭena mām |
nakhalubdhamayaṃ hanta kāntāyāḥ smārayatyalam || 48 ||

bimbacchāyāmadharamaṇinā dāḍimībījakāntiṃ
dantaiḥ kurvatyalakamahasā rājajambūphalābhām |

dṛṣṭā kiṃ te sutanurathavā mañjubhāṣiṇyadṛṣṭā
yenādyāpi tyajasi na punaḥ prāpya teṣu tvamāsthām || 49 ||

sp.p:
anyataḥ parikrāmannagrato vilokya eṣa khalu lavaṅgatarumūlabaddhamaṇḍalā
bhirhariṇībhiranvāsyamānaḥ kṛṣṇasāraḥ | anuyokṣye tāvadenam | vibhāvya
manye sāṃpratamavasaro mamābhiyogasya | yataḥ,

lg.l: visaradvanapuṣpasaurabhabhramadindindiragītirāgataḥ |
daramīlitalocanaṃ sthito mukhamutkaṇṭhamayaṃ vahan mṛgaḥ || 50 ||

kuṭilamalake śoṇaṃ bimbādhare taralaṃ dṛśo
rvacasi madhuraṃ mandaṃ līlāsmite natamaṃsayoḥ |

urasijayuge tuṅgaṃ madhye kṛśaṃ jaghane ghanaṃ
kathaya vipine dṛṣṭaṃ sāraṅga kiṃ mama jīvitam || 51 ||

sp.p:
vibhāvya hanta māmapi kṛtapraṇayaprayatnaṃ na gaṇayatyeṣaḥ | kiṃ vā
nidānamavinayasyāsya | vicintya ā jñātam ;

lg.l: jitanayanakāntireṣa tṛṇacaraṇaḥ śaraṇatāṃ tayā nītaḥ |
saṃprati tu garvitaḥ syāt kathaṃ na tasyāmadṛśyāyām || 52 ||

sp.p:
kiṃ mama parābhyudayāsahiṣṇunānena? parikrāmitakena sadṛṣṭikṣepamāvegaṃ
nāṭayan
tathyamatisnehaḥ pāpaśaṅkīti | yataḥ,

lg.l:
āśaṅkya me kimapi rātricarairabhadraṃ
dehaṃ nijaṃ niyatamujjhitumīhamānā |

jvālākalāpaparivalganadāruṇe'smin
dāvānale nipatituṃ dayitā pravṛttā || 53 ||

virama virama sāhasādakāṇḍe
sutanu saṃnihitaḥ sa eṣa rāmaḥ |

ayi tava virahānalena dagdhaṃ
viracaya nirvṛtamenamaṅgakaistvam || 54 ||
lohitaprasavaśāli palāśāraṇyametadabhito na davāgniḥ |
kācidantaragatā ca manojñā vallarī na hi videhasutā me || 55 ||

anuvanalatākuñjaṃ guñjannupaiti nivartate
viracayati na svādau puṣpāsave'pi kutūhalam |

bhramati ca yato dūrādindindiro'hamivāyama
pyapagatavatīṃ kāntāmanveṣayatyadhikotsukaḥ || 56 ||
kundāravindakuvalayamadhūkabandhūkacampakaiḥ khacitā |
api cañcarīka dṛṣṭā kācana saṃcāriṇī latikā || 57 ||

sp.p: vibhāvya svadārānveṣaṇaparo'yaṃ na paśyatyeva me kāntām |
puro'valokya iyaṃ hi godāvarī bhagavatī | niśvasya

lg.l:
iha khalu tarumūle sā niṣaṇṇā natabhrū
riha suciramaraṃstopāntavānīrakuñje |

iha khalu kalahaṃsaiḥ saikateṣu vyahārṣī
diti niyatadṛśo me hanta śāntiḥ kadā nu || 58 ||
śātodarī kva nu gatā godāvari darśayāśu vaidehīm |
āsandhyamarcayati me sumukhī nanu raktasandhyakairbhavatīm || 59 ||

śaivālaprakareṇa kuntalabharaṃ vaktraśriyaṃ paṅkajai
rvīcībhirbhruvamakṣiṇī kuvalayairbāhuṃ mṛṇālāṅkuraiḥ |

cakrāhvaiḥ stanakumbhavibhramamathāvartena nābhihradaṃ
śroṇī saikatamaṇḍalena sahasā nirmāya tāṃ dehi me || 60 ||

sp.p:
kathamaprativacanenaivāvatiṣṭhata iyam | vicintya na khalu sītāvi
lopapātakinaṃ māmabhimukhīkuryādiyam | apasarāmi tāvadahameva | tathā
kṛtvā sadṛṣṭikṣepam
nanvayaṃ maithilīsahāyasya me vilāsasaudhāyamāno
mālyavān | asya khalu guhāgṛhe jātu,

lg.l:
tasyā gaṇḍatale mayā vilikhitā patrāvalī dhātunā
vāsantīṃ pulake sati smitavatīṃ sā vañcayantī sakhīm |

sītā nirjharamārutānapadiśantyabhyarṇaratnasthale
saṃkrāntapratimaṃ nirīkṣya ca mukhaṃ svinnaṃ bhṛśaṃ lajjitā || 61 ||

sp.p:
tadimamatiduḥkhadarśanaṃ nopasarpāmi | parikrāman aye, kariṇī
sahāyo'yamadhimārgamupagato mattamātaṅgayūthapatiḥ | saspṛham

lg.l: karadhṛtanalinīdalātapatro mṛdutaralīkṛtakarṇatālavṛntaḥ |
caladalibṛndacārugītacāṭuḥ priyakariṇīmanuvartate gajendraḥ || 62 ||
upagamya samunnataikapādaṃ madatandrīmanusaṃdadhānamantaḥ |
radane'sya rasāt svamakṣikoṇaṃ nanu kaṇḍūyitumudyatā kareṇuḥ || 63 ||

brūhi tvaṃ dviradendra candravadanā kiṃ dṛśyate jānakī
jānīṣe na yadi bravīmi bhavatastallakṣaṇaṃ śrūyatām |

ūrū tvatkarakāṇḍabandhuratarau tvatkumbhakalpau kucau
cārī caṅkramacāturīṃ ca sutanorūrīkarotyeva te || 64 ||

sp.p:
vibhāvya ayamanākarṇitamadvacanaḥ priyāṃ kareṇumahimakarakiraṇatā
pāsahāṃ karaśīkarairāśvāsayati | anubhavatu tāvadayaṃ kāntānuvartanasukham |

anyato dṛṣṭvā aye ko'yamanekabhujaparighabhīṣaṇākāro rākṣasaḥ praṇayinīṃ
me kalakaruṇākranditāṃ harati? iti niṣaṅgādbāṇamādāya vibhāvya ca hanta,
sādṛśyādvipralabdho'smi | kutaḥ,

lg.l:
tāpiñcho ghananīla eṣa malinākāro na naktaṃcara
stasyaite viṭapāḥ prakāmavikaṭā nābhogavanto bhujāḥ |

tatreyaṃ navapallavā vanalatā nālaṃkṛtā jānakī
kiṃcaitatkurarīrutaṃ sakaruṇaṃ dīnaṃ na tatkranditam || 65 ||

sp.p:
stokamantaraṃ gatvā hanta, pariśrānto'smi | ((iti dhanuravaṣṭabhya
kṣaṇamātraṃ sthitvā))

lg.l: pampā kṛtānukampā saṃprati sītāviyogataptaṃ mām |
kalhārakaravikīrṇairāśvāsayatīva śīkaraiḥ śītaiḥ || 66 ||
sākṣādiva vanalakṣmīrihāgatā maithilī tvayā pampe |
kaccinmama rambhorūrambhoruhavanavihāriṇī dṛṣṭā || 67 ||

sp.p:
vibhāvya nūnaṃ sārasarutāpa da de śena māmasau pṛcchati ‘kutaḥ kathaṃ vā
gatā jānakī’ iti | āvedayāmi tāvadbhūtārtham |

lg.l:
nīto'smi kenacidahaṃ kuhanāmṛgeṇa
dūraṃ punaḥ sapadi pañcava rṭī ṭīṃ nivṛttaḥ |

anveṣayannapi na tāmavalokayāmi
jīvāmi caiṣa kimataḥ paramasti kaṣṭam || 68 ||

sp.p: vicintya bhagavati pampe, ataḥ paraṃ tvamapi śocanīyāsi | yataḥ,

lg.l:
galitatilakamākulārdrakeśaṃ
pulakitagaṇḍamanañjanāruṇākṣam |

kalayasi dhavalādharaṃ na tasyāḥ
kimapi mukhaṃ jalakelidohalinyāḥ || 69 ||

sp.p:
sadṛṣṭikṣepam kaṣṭamiyaṃ mama virahatāpaniḥsahā kaṇṭhadaghnamavagāhate
saraḥ | upasṛtya vibhāvya ca

lg.l: kathamidaṃ vilasacchadamunmadabhramaramujjvalakarṇikamambujam |
na mama vāmadṛśo rucirādharaṃ taralalocanamindusamānanam || 70 ||

sp.p:
pārśvato dṛṣṭvā śakyamidānīṃ kiṃcidāśvasitum |
nanu dṛśyata eva kaṇṭhanālādgalitā hāralatā saroruhākṣyāḥ |

lg.l: śaradindumarīcikomaleyaṃ sarasā haṃsamukhacyutā mṛṇālī || 71 ||
anyonyadattamṛdujagdhamṛṇālabhaṅgamutpakṣmalaprasṛtapakṣma kṛtāṅgapāli |
kandarpakelikalakūjitakāntametadābhāti haṃsamithunaṃ savilāsamagre || 72 ||

kathayatamiha dṛṣṭā kiṃnu me vallabhā yā
mṛdulagativilāsairvrīḍitau vāṃ vyatānīt |

kimapi manasi kṛtvā hanta mātsaryamanta
rmayi virahiṇi kāryā na hyupekṣā yuvābhyām || 73 ||

ambhojaṃ vadanena saurabhabhṛtā bimbādharacchāyayā
bandhūkaṃ kumudaṃ smitena śapharavyāvartanaṃ cakṣuṣā |

ālāpaiḥ śukajalpitaṃ stanataṭīhāreṇa tārāvaliṃ
sā velāsvapi vārṣikīṣu yuvayornirmāya tuṣṭiṃ vyadhāt || 74 ||
racitaḥ sukhāntarāyaḥ kasya kadā vā mayā na vijñātam |
tasyaivāyaṃ hi vipākaḥ kathaṃ hi bhūyastameva kurvīya || 75 ||

etāni saṃnidadhate khalu vīciḍolā
līlāvihārataralīkṛtapakṣmalāni |

utkaṇṭhitāni darakuḍmalitekṣaṇāni
rāgānvitāni mithunāni rathāṅganāmnām || 76 ||

sp.p:
kṣaṇaṃ pratipālya kathamadyāpi tathaiva vartante | saroṣamiva
sarvaiḥ khalu paribhūyate yācakajanaḥ |

lg.l:
sītāpravṛttimadhigantumanā bhavadbhyo
rāmaḥ kilaiṣa bhavatāṃ samayaṃ na labdhā |

adya prabhṛtyanuniśaṃ vacanānmadīyā
dāyāta yūyamitaretaraviprayogam || 77 ||
pāṭalādharadalā ghanastanī lobhanīyabhujanālaśobhinī |
susmitā kuṭilanīlakuntalā jānakī kathamiyaṃ samāgatā || 78 ||

sp.p:
yāvadasyāḥ pariṣvaṅgapraṇayī bhavāmi | vibhāvya, saviṣādam āḥ,
dūre tāvadevaṃvidhāni bhāgadheyāni rāmasya |

lg.l:
ātāmrābhaṃ kisalayamidaṃ naiva bimbādharaśrī
reṣā śākhā stabakanamitā naiva bāhuḥ stanāṅkaḥ |

etatpuṣpaṃ na hasitamaliśreṇireṣā na veṇī
vāsantīyaṃ vanabhuvi latā vallabhā me na sītā || 79 ||
tadidaṃ maṇinūpuraṃ priyāyāḥ patitaṃ pādasaroruhādadhanyam |
prasarannavamauktikāṃśujālavyapadeśena vimuñcatīva bāṣpam || 80 ||
tulayati caraṇaścaladbhruvo virahitamauktikanū puradhvaniḥ |
anuditakusumaṃ ca pallavaṃ vyapagatahaṃsaravaṃ ca paṅkajam || 81 ||
mihikālaghu maithilātmajāyā bahumānādanasūyayā vitīrṇam |
tadidaṃ haritāruṇāntarekhaṃ taruśākhāgrathitaṃ stanottarīyam || 82 ||

sp.p:
vicintya nūnamidamambaracareṇa kenacidapahriyamāṇāyāḥ stanataṭā
dapabhraśyannipatitaṃ syāt | tadimāmeva saraṇimanusarāmi | iti tathā kṛtvā
hanta,

lg.l:
āśoka eṣa sa cakoradṛśo vataṃsaḥ
karṇārpiteyamapi kesaramālikā sā |

etāni tāni khalu garbhakacampakāni
seyaṃ namerukusumagrathitā ca kāñcī || 83 ||
ekākinī sā vipine carantī vikīrṇasūnaprakare samantāt |
prasahya hiṃ strai srai ḥ pramadā madīyā hṛtāvaluptāvayavā bhavet kim || 84 ||

pratyagrakṣatajāruṇīkṛtamukhāḥ kasya syurete śarāḥ
kasyāśīviṣabhogabhīṣaṇamidaṃ bhagnaṃ tathā kārmukam |

kasyāyaṃ truṭitadhvajo'vamṛditasrastākṣakūpo rathaḥ
kasyedaṃ ca vibhāti rakṣasa iva kṣoṇyāṃ vigāḍhaṃ padam || 85 ||

sp.p:
vibhāvya prāyaḥ kenāpi rākṣasena sutanurapahṛtā syāt | ((pārśvato
'valokya)) kathamasaṃnihito rakṣovadhakṛtakṣaṇasya me sāhyakaro vatsasaumitriḥ |
yaḥ khalu,

lg.l: sārdhaṃ mayā gādhivarānmaharṣeravāptadivyāstrasusaṃpradāyaḥ |
lebhe dhanurvaiṣṇavamakṣayeṣu pūrṇau niṣaṅgāvapi kumbhayoneḥ || 86 ||
bāṇaiḥ kalpakṣayakrudhyatkṛtāntāpāṅgabhīṣaṇaiḥ |
arākṣasaṃ jagatkṛtvā pratyāneṣyāmi jānakīm || 87 ||

sp.p:
jaya jaya jagatpate kausalyānayanānandakandalanakālamegha rāmacandra
kṛtamadhunā te prayāsena |

lg.l: sītāṃ haṭhādapahṛtāṃ rundhan pathi pātito daśāsyena |
āvedayajjaṭāyuḥ śatrughnajyāyase divaṃ yāsyan || 88 ||

vālinyunmūlite drākpramuditamanasaḥ sūryaputrasya sāhyā
dbaddhe setau kapīndrairlavaṇajalanidhiṃ lakṣmaṇo laṅghayitvā |

hatvā paulastyamājau saha rajanijaraiḥ sendrajitkumbhakarṇaṃ
devīmādāya bhūyastava savidhamasāvāgataḥ puṣpakeṇa || 89 ||
ito vimānādavatīrya divyādasaṃkhyarakṣaḥkapisevito'yam |
sītāṃ puraskṛtya viyogakhinnāṃ saumitrirabhyeti mamopakaṇṭham || 90 ||
bhūyo'pi bhāgyaśeṣeṇa pratyāvṛttāsi saṃprati |
gateva saṃpadandheva dṛṣṭirvidyeva vismṛtā || 91 ||

sugrīvo naḥ priyasuhṛdasau cakravartī harīṇā
masyāmātyeṣvayamatibalo vāyusūnurhanūmān |

asmānprāptaḥ śaraṇamanujo rāvaṇasyaiṣa vīraḥ
sarve'pyete vidadhati namastubhyamālokayaitān || 92 ||

p.seg:
eso seuṇibandhādo puḍamaṃ eva samuddalaṃghaṇaṃ viraia laṃkāmuvaado
maṃ assāsidavaṃto haṇumaṃto |jayatvāryaputraḥ |

lg.l:
vijitya kila vāsavaṃ yudhi cakāra kārāgṛhe
salīlamudacālayat kila bhujaiḥ kuberācalam |

muhuḥ kila nijairmukhairgiriśamarcayāmāsa yo
hataḥ sa iti kīrtanaṃ kimapi labdhamikṣvākubhiḥ || 93 ||

paulastya eṣa kṛtavīryasutena baddho
janye jaghāna kila taṃ jamadagnirāmaḥ |

āryeṇa so'pi gamitaḥ sahasā praśāntiṃ
ko vātra yastrijagatāṃ vijayī pravīraḥ || 94 ||

catvāraḥ sahajā manuṣyavapuṣā yūyaṃ hareraṃśakāḥ
sīteyaṃ kamalā vanaukasa ime sarve'pi nākaukasaḥ |

yātāḥ saṃprati tāścaturdaśa samāḥ sāketametya tvayā
bhūyo'pi triyugāvirodhicaritenārādhanīyāḥ prajāḥ || 95 ||

p.seg: ayyautta kiṃ avaraṃ ahmāṇaṃ kumāralakkhaṇo piaṃ karedu |eṣa setunibandhātprāgeva samudralaṅghanaṃ viracayya laṅkāmupagato māmā- śvāsitavān hanumān |

lg.l:
hṛcchalyaṃ daśakandharastribhuvanasyāsīt samutmūlitaḥ
sugrīvaśca vibhīṣaṇaśca suhṛdau sve sve pade sthāpitau |

cittāhlādanacandrikā tvamapi me pratyāhṛtāsi priye
saumitrirvijayī kimanyadadhunā diṣṭyā vivardhāmahe || 96 ||

kāle varṣantu meghāḥ phalatu vasumatī bhadramastu prajānāṃ
hṛdyāḥ svairaṃ kavīnāṃ khalahṛdayabhidaḥ santu vidyāvinodāḥ |

ekāvāsaḥ kalānāṃ vitaraṇavibhavanyakkṛtāmartyaśākhī
samrāḍ jāgartu dīrghaṃ hariharatanayaḥ śrīvirūpākṣabhūpaḥ || 97 ||
